lines.text: Moses tells Israel that the LORD goes across the Jordan ahead of them as a consuming fire.
Moses says the LORD drives out the nations because of their wickedness, not because Israel is righteous.
Moses stays on the mountain forty days and forty nights, and Joshua inscribes the two stone tablets.

wrong_details.wrong: Joshua inscribes the two stone tablets
wrong_details.true: God inscribed the tablets with His own finger

lines.text: Moses sees the molten calf, shatters the tablets, prays for Aaron, and burns the calf and grinds it to dust.
Moses makes an ark of acacia wood, and the LORD writes on new tablets, which Moses keeps in his tent.

wrong_details.wrong: Moses keeps the tablets in his tent
wrong_details.true: Moses placed the tablets in the ark he had made
